note: Third domain (P146): Python semantic traps — LLM-known weakness zone. Binary: will this code pass these tests? Verifier = execution. Traps chosen from the classic silent-behavior class (mutable defaults, late binding, banker rounding, shallow copy, generator exhaustion, chained-return None).

items.trap: mutable default argument shared across calls

def make_adders():
    return [lambda x: x + i for i in range(3)]

adders = make_adders()
results = [adders[0](10), adders[1](10), adders[2](10)]

    return [lambda x, i=i: x + i for i in range(3)]

adders = make_adders()
results = [adders[0](10), adders[1](10), adders[2](10)]
